objective: Create append-only canonical historical evidence that an insurance relationship reached quoted or bound, so future quote and bind numerators do not depend on mutable current quoteStatus or economic premium assumptions.
rules: Current InsuranceLeadProfile.quoteStatus remains current state and is not redefined as historical evidence.
Lost and declined do not imply historical quotation.
A written premium fact remains an economic fact and is not redefined as a bound lifecycle event.
Quoted and bound outcomes are explicit append-only facts.
Each outcome fact has its own stable outcomeFactId.
Outcome facts require relationshipId, kind, and occurredAt.
Provider, policy, and external references are optional metadata.
Batch reads require an explicit finite relationship cohort.
Empty batch cohorts perform zero SQL reads.
No conversion rate is calculated in this slice.
